title: kube-proxy iptables mode drops traffic to Service after EndpointSlice update
body: After scaling a Deployment down and back up, connections to the ClusterIP Service intermittently fail for ~30s. kube-proxy logs show it syncing iptables rules but the stale endpoint isn't removed until the next full resync. Seen on v1.30 in iptables mode; nftables mode not affected. NetworkPolicy is not in use.
